items.source:
Note: Implementations should not close the given OutputStream
(or any decorators of that OutputStream) but rather leave this up
to the caller.
items.translation: 注意：实现不应关闭给定的 OutputStream（或其任何装饰器），而应将其留由调用者处理。

items.source: Turn an object of type T into a serialized byte array.
items.translation: 将类型为 T 的对象转换为序列化的字节数组。

items.source: IOException - in case of serialization failure
items.translation: IOException - 在序列化失败的情况下

items.source: A strategy interface for streaming an object to an OutputStream.
items.translation: 用于将对象流式传输到 OutputStream 的策略接口。

items.source: Write an object of type T to the given OutputStream.
items.translation: 将类型为 T 的对象写入指定的 OutputStream。

items.source: IOException - in case of errors writing to the stream
items.translation: IOException - 在写入流时发生错误的情况下

items.source: This is a functional interface and can therefore be used as the assignment target for a lambda expression or method reference.
items.translation: 这是一个功能接口，因此可用作 Lambda 表达式或方法引用的赋值目标。

items.source: Gary Russell, Mark Fisher, Juergen Hoeller
